spec.rawSql: WITH ValidEdges AS (SELECT nn.node_id AS reporter, nn.neighbor_id AS neighbor FROM node_neighbors nn JOIN node_details nd_source ON nn.node_id = nd_source.node_id JOIN node_details nd_target ON nn.neighbor_id = nd_target.node_id WHERE $__timeFilter(nn.time) AND nd_source.role IN ($role) AND nd_target.role IN ($role) AND substring(nd_source.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/[^/]+$') IN ($channel) AND substring(nd_target.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/[^/]+$') IN ($channel)), PairStats AS (SELECT LEAST(reporter, neighbor) AS node_a, GREATEST(reporter, neighbor) AS node_b FROM ValidEdges GROUP BY LEAST(reporter, neighbor), GREATEST(reporter, neighbor) HAVING COUNT(*) >= ${link_threshold}) SELECT nd.node_id::text AS id, nd.long_name AS title, nd.role AS "subTitle", nd.short_name AS "mainStat", CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM node_neighbors nn_check WHERE nn_check.node_id = nd.node_id AND $__timeFilter(nn_check.time)) THEN 'green' ELSE 'red' END AS color FROM node_details nd WHERE nd.node_id IN (SELECT node_a FROM PairStats UNION SELECT node_b FROM PairStats)

WITH ReporterTotals AS (SELECT node_id, COUNT(DISTINCT packet_id) AS total_packets FROM node_neighbors WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY node_id), ValidEdges AS (SELECT nn.node_id AS reporter, nn.neighbor_id AS neighbor, nn.snr AS raw_snr FROM node_neighbors nn JOIN node_details nd_source ON nn.node_id = nd_source.node_id JOIN node_details nd_target ON nn.neighbor_id = nd_target.node_id WHERE $__timeFilter(nn.time) AND nd_source.role IN ($role) AND nd_target.role IN ($role) AND substring(nd_source.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/[^/]+$') IN ($channel) AND substring(nd_target.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/[^/]+$') IN ($channel)), PairStats AS (SELECT LEAST(reporter, neighbor) AS node_a, GREATEST(reporter, neighbor) AS node_b, COUNT(*) AS actual_reports, SUM(CASE WHEN reporter = LEAST(reporter, neighbor) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a_hears_b, SUM(CASE WHEN reporter = GREATEST(reporter, neighbor) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b_hears_a, (AVG(raw_snr) / 4.0)::numeric AS avg_snr FROM ValidEdges GROUP BY LEAST(reporter, neighbor), GREATEST(reporter, neighbor) HAVING COUNT(*) >= ${link_threshold}) SELECT p.node_a || '-' || p.node_b AS id, (CASE WHEN p.a_hears_b >= p.b_hears_a THEN p.node_b ELSE p.node_a END)::text AS source, (CASE WHEN p.a_hears_b >= p.b_hears_a THEN p.node_a ELSE p.node_b END)::text AS target, ROUND(LEAST(100.0, (((p.avg_snr + 15.0) / 30.0) * 100.0) + LEAST(100.0, (p.actual_reports::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(rt_a.total_packets, 0) + COALESCE(rt_b.total_packets, 0), 0)) * 100.0)) / 2.0, 1) AS "mainStat", GREATEST(1.0, ROUND(LEAST(100.0, ((((p.avg_snr + 15.0) / 30.0) * 100.0) + LEAST(100.0, (p.actual_reports::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(rt_a.total_packets, 0) + COALESCE(rt_b.total_packets, 0), 0)) * 100.0)) / 2.0) / 10.0, 1)) AS thickness, p.actual_reports AS "secondaryStat", ROUND(LEAST(100.0, (p.actual_reports::numeric / NULLIF(COALESCE(rt_a.total_packets, 0) + COALESCE(rt_b.total_packets, 0), 0)) * 100.0), 1) || '%' AS "detail__Consistency", ROUND(p.avg_snr, 2) || ' dB' AS "detail__Average SNR", CASE WHEN p.a_hears_b > 0 AND p.b_hears_a > 0 THEN 'Two-Way' ELSE 'One-Way' END AS "detail__Link Type" FROM PairStats p LEFT JOIN ReporterTotals rt_a ON p.node_a = rt_a.node_id LEFT JOIN ReporterTotals rt_b ON p.node_b = rt_b.node_id

spec.definition: SELECT DISTINCT substring(last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/[^/]+$') AS channel FROM node_details WHERE last_heard_topic IS NOT NULL AND substring(last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/[^/]+$') != '' ORDER BY channel ASC;
